summary: Nuburu filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) disclosing two agreements effective September 30, 2026. A Side Letter with Esousa Group Holdings and other purchasers amends the Black-Scholes Value definition in a July 17, 2026 pre-funded warrant, has certain Series B preferred holders forfeit shares issuable at conversion prices below $0.10, and imposes monthly penalties if registration deadlines are missed. Separately, Nuburu returned 295,000 Heckler & Koch ordinary shares to Brick Lane, cancelling a $15 million convertible note issued February 6, 2026. Watch warrant reset and registration-driven dilution risk.
